summary: The episode analyzes two Norwegian companies. Bevvi, an insulation manufacturer struggling with high debt and poor cash flow after recent share placement. Salaris, an HR and payroll services company with managed services and consulting segments, showing strong fundamentals with recurring revenue from blue chip clients, 15-18% historical growth, improving margins toward 17-18%, and attractive valuation at EV/EBIT ~8-9x.
key_takeaways: Bevvi underwent restructuring with new emission after debt problems, but struggles continue
Salaris has strong recurring revenue model with 90% recurring in managed services segment
Salaris trading near all-time low valuation despite strong growth and improving margins
Founder-CEO owns 13% of Salaris, providing strong founder incentives
